problem.title: Smallest Range Covering K Sorted Lists
problem.problemStatement: Given K sorted lists of integers, determine the smallest inclusive range that contains at least one element from every list.
problem.input: • First line contains integer K. • For each list, the number of elements followed by the sorted elements.
problem.output: Print the starting and ending values of the smallest range.
